correctness.rationale: Subdivide by nonempty matching flags. A flag stabilizer fixes each vertex by its distinct cardinality; faces obtained by different deletions also have different cardinality signatures. The geometric quotient therefore has oriented flag-orbit cells and the ordinary signed deletion boundary, without stabilizer weights. An independent ordered-set-partition enumeration with generator-based orbit floods reproduced cell counts (45,308,744,720,240), verified all integer boundary composites, and computed the nonzero Smith factors of the unreduced four boundary maps as 1^44, 1^264, (1^478,5,5), 1^240. The free homology ranks are (1,0,0,0,0); the coker of the following boundary has the same torsion as homology because the residual image is free. A separate collapse reproduction also recovered 240 and 404 geometric free-face pairs and the reduced integral data. The chessboard connectivity bound is min(5,5,floor(11/3))−2=1, so the cover is simply connected. Every generating three-cycle of A5 fixes an unmoved diagonal square; Armstrong's finite-action orbit-space result gives simple connectivity of the quotient. By Hurewicz the two independent classes of H₂ lift to classes in π₂ of order five, and their representatives extend across two degree-five attachments. The resulting map from the wedge induces isomorphisms in every integral homology degree and hence is a homotopy equivalence by simply connected homological Whitehead.
residual_risks: Finite computation is exhaustive for this single board and action only and does not prove the invoked general topology theorems. No homeomorphism, freeness or equivariant classification is inferred.

value.rationale: The five-label chessboard is a small natural matching complex with integral torsion, and the canonical index-two even subgroup of its simultaneous relabeling action is not an arbitrary subgroup. Its exact quotient shows that the one five-primary Moore summand in the symmetric quotient becomes two under the even relabeling action, whereas the cyclic quotient has different torsion again. The exact integral type resolves an identifiable comparison that ordinary connectivity or rational homology misses.
residual_risks: This comparison does not supply an all-board-size pattern or classify other subgroup actions.
